+"""
+Loads images named by a stored reference (cut image_path, style reference,
+profile image, ...).
+
+These references can be set by users, so they are never requested over HTTP:
+that would let a user make the backend call any address it can reach
+(internal services, cloud metadata) and read the response. A reference is
+only ever resolved to one of:
+
+- a `data:` URL, decoded in place;
+- an object in our own storage, read through the storage client. It is named
+  by its relative path or by its public URL (one of our storage URL prefixes).
+
+Anything else (any other URL) is refused.
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+import os
+from typing import List, Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _storage_url_prefixes() -> List[str]:
+    """Public URL prefixes under which the objects of our bucket are served."""
+    prefixes = []
+    if settings.STORAGE_HOST:
+        prefixes.append(settings.STORAGE_HOST.rstrip("/"))
+    bucket = settings.MINIO_BUCKET
+    if os.getenv("STORAGE_TYPE", "minio").lower() == "gcs":
+        bucket = bucket or os.getenv("GCS_BUCKET_NAME", "toonify-prod-assets")
+        prefixes.append(f"https://storage.googleapis.com/{bucket}")
+    elif settings.MINIO_ENDPOINT and bucket:
+        protocol = "https" if settings.MINIO_SECURE else "http"
+        prefixes.append(f"{protocol}://{settings.MINIO_ENDPOINT}/{bucket}")
+    return [p + "/" for p in prefixes if "://" in p]
+
+
+def storage_key(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """
+    Returns the path inside our storage bucket that `ref` names, or None if
+    `ref` does not name an object in our storage.
+    """
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    ref = ref.strip()
+    if "://" in ref or ref.startswith("//"):
+        for prefix in _storage_url_prefixes():
+            if ref.startswith(prefix):
+                key = ref[len(prefix):].split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]
+                key = unquote(key)
+                break
+        else:
+            return None
+    else:
+        key = ref
+    key = key.lstrip("/")
+    parts = key.split("/")
+    if not key or "\\" in key or ":" in parts[0] or any(p in ("", ".", "..") for p in parts):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """
+    Returns the bytes of the image `ref` names, or None if it cannot be loaded.
+    Never makes an HTTP request to an address taken from `ref`.
+    """
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    if ref.startswith("data:"):
+        try:
+            _header, encoded = ref.split(",", 1)
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+        except (ValueError, binascii.Error):
+            return None
+
+    key = storage_key(ref)
+    if key is None:
+        logger.warning("Refused to load an image from outside our storage", ref=ref[:100])
+        return None
+
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    try:
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image from storage", key=key, error=str(e))
+        return None

+"""An export says which cuts it left out: the X-Missing-Cuts header (both
+formats) and missing.txt in the ZIP."""
+import base64
+
+import pytest
+
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.test_image_source import make_episode, no_network, put_in_storage, zip_members  # noqa: F401
+
+DATA_URL = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+REFUSED = "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/"
+NOT_AN_IMAGE = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(b"not an image").decode()
+
+
+def export(client, headers, episode_id, fmt):
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=headers)
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_the_cuts_it_left_out(client, no_network):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(
+        client,
+        h,
+        [
+            DATA_URL,
+            None,  # 2: no image yet
+            REFUSED,  # 3: an address the backend refuses
+            put_in_storage("cuts/e1/ok.png"),
+            "cuts/e1/gone.png",  # 5: not in storage
+        ],
+    )
+
+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,5"
+    assert zip_members(r) == {
+        "Episode_1_01.png": PNG,
+        "Episode_1_04.png": PNG,
+        "missing.txt": b"2\n3\n5\n",
+    }
+    assert no_network == []
+
+
+def test_webtoon_lists_the_cuts_it_left_out(client, no_network):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(
+        client,
+        h,
+        [None, DATA_URL, REFUSED, "cuts/e1/gone.png", NOT_AN_IMAGE, put_in_storage("cuts/e1/ok.png")],
+    )
+
+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, "webtoon")
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["content-type"] == "image/png"
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "1,3,4,5"
+    assert no_network == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_nothing_missing_means_no_header_and_no_missing_txt(client, no_network, fmt):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h, [DATA_URL, put_in_storage("cuts/e1/ok.png")])
+
+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, fmt)
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+    if fmt == "zip":
+        assert sorted(zip_members(r)) == ["Episode_1_01.png", "Episode_1_02.png"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_an_export_with_no_usable_cut_still_fails_and_names_them(client, no_network, fmt):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h, [None, REFUSED])
+
+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, fmt)
+
+    assert r.status_code == 400, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "1,2"
+
+
+def test_browsers_may_read_the_header_across_origins(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h, [DATA_URL, None])
+
+    r = client.post(

+
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2"
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" in r.headers["access-control-expose-headers"]
